item.title: OCC Imposes $750 Million Assessment Against Bank of America for Deficient BSA/AML Compliance
item.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today announced a $750 million civil money penalty against Bank of America, N.A. (bank), for violations of the Bank Secrecy Act and its implementing regulations, including 12 CFR 21.21 and 12 CFR 21.11. This amount is the largest in OCC history.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: OCC Allows National Banks and Federal Savings Associations in Alabama, Florida, and Mississippi Affected by Hurricane Isaias to Close
item.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today issued a proclamation allowing national banks, federal savings associations, and federal branches and agencies of foreign banks to close offices in areas of Alabama and Mississippi affected by Hurricane Isaias.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: OCC Assesses $350 Million Civil Money Penalty Against American Express
item.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today announced a cease-and-desist order and a $350 million civil money penalty against American Express National Bank, Sandy, Utah (bank), for deficiencies in the bank's Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and anti-money laundering (AML) compliance program.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: Comptroller Gould Announces New Efforts to Combat Financial Fraud in Minnesota
item.description: Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan V. Gould today convened a panel of community bankers in Minneapolis, Minnesota, to discuss ongoing efforts to combat financial fraud.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: OCC Hails 2026 Update to U.S. National Strategy for Financial Literacy
item.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today hailed the 2026 update to the U.S. National Strategy for Financial Literacy, underscoring the agency's commitment to helping Americans develop practical skills to make sound financial decisions, build greater financial security, and pursue economic opportunity.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: OCC Releases CRA Performance Evaluations for 13 National Banks and Federal Savings Associations
item.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today released a list of Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) performance evaluations that became public during the period of September 1, 2026, through September 30, 2026.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: OCC Reports Second Quarter 2026 Bank Trading Revenue
item.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) reported cumulative trading revenue of U.S. commercial banks and savings associations of $21.6 billion in the second quarter of 2026. The second quarter trading revenue was $5.3 billion, or 32.5 percent, more than in the previous quarter and $5.1 billion, or 30.6 percent, more than a year earlier.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.category: Capital Markets, Derivatives, Treasury & Market Risk
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: Comptroller Issues Statement Explaining Vote Against Resolution Plan Feedback for American Express, Reasserts Need for Reforms to Resolution Planning
item.description: Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan V. Gould today issued a statement on his vote against a joint resolution plan letter from the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation and the Federal Reserve Board to American Express and reaffirmed the need for reforms to Dodd-Frank Act Section 165(d) resolution plans.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: Remarks by Comptroller Gould before the Military Banking Summit 2026
item.description: Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan V. Gould today discussed the importance of a regulatory and supervisory framework that supports the military community in remarks at the Military Banking Summit.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: OCC Reports Mortgage Performance for Second Quarter of 2026
item.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) reported on the performance of first-lien mortgages in the federal banking system during the second quarter of 2026.
